Review the current file for security defects only.

For each finding report: severity (high/medium/low), the exact line, why it is exploitable,
and a concrete patch. Rank findings by severity. If you find nothing at a given severity, say so
explicitly rather than inventing a finding. Finish with the single change that removes the most risk.
